review.summary: The executable DAG is structurally ready against COINHUB-CRITICAL-JOURNEYS R10 and COINHUB-E2E-001 R10. It routes work through the stated long-lived owners and scopes; makes deterministic foundation precede API/Worker behavioral producers and all journey work; keeps API and Worker implementation scopes respectively limited to src/api/** and worker/**; sequences runner registration only after the respective tests exist; and makes the final registry update rerun command-contract plus every registered suite before the integrated acceptance/typecheck/build gate. The browser producer verification bindings invoke scripts/playwright-acceptance.mjs, and the harness task defines the required pre-load PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 wrapper and actual launch/DOM/external-network-block/clean-close smoke, resolving the prior wrapper-binding plan issue. The current repository evidence confirms the baseline has no test:acceptance script or test tree, so no future producer is falsely represented as an existing prerequisite. ownerFeedbackFacts concerning a previous Worker configuration-write conflict were considered as non-blocking execution evidence only; the revised Worker task explicitly uses test-injected bindings and does not require wrangler.local.jsonc, consistent with the frozen R10 source.
